items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: But Gene Kelly, it was his show, he wasn’t in it. He didn’t perform in it, but it was his show. He’s the one that produced it and everything. And I met him you know, he’s a nice guy, we shook hands, and I met Gene Kelly

ctx.x: Well you seem to have a good business sense for a musician, because you ended up doing like some contracting.
Oh I really did. Gene Kelly and Nelson Riddle and — oh I can tell you a lot of stories if you want to hear some of them.
That’s why we’re here. Well I think, I did a little of that myself, and I think that can be a high pressure thing because you’re hiring people and you really need them to do a great job.
